title: M11 exact-zero privacy-compatible route shortlist
purpose: Read-only screening of current exact-zero routes against structured/tool capability, provider data-use policy and retained M1 interface evidence. No inference, credential access, retry, configuration or deployment change.

result.decision: No currently listed explicit exact-zero route besides Qwen meets the provider ZDR/no-training screen. Qwen is operationally unavailable in the retained M1 evidence after repeated shared-pool 429s, including the single 25 September probe; therefore no replacement is selectable or qualified.

limits: Catalog/provider metadata establishes advertised interfaces and policies, not live compatibility or reliable uptime.
No route with both a current exact-zero listing and provider ZDR/no-training policy (other than repeatedly rate-limited Qwen) can be selected from this inventory.
Streaming capability is supported by retained M1 observations for Dots/Liquid/Nemotron only; Qwen has no observed stream response.
The generic openrouter/free aggregate route is not a substitute because provider/model identity and data terms can vary.
next_action: Keep M11-OPS-02b open; continue independent work. Do not repeat the Qwen probe or add a provider-retaining route to a default chain.
